source: evals/climb-history.json: real runs of evals/hill.mjs against BRANE (draft policies, POST /policy/test) on Omar Shalaby's selection split omar-val, and of evals/legal.mjs on the hard legal questions. start is the baseline before the first change, end is after the last kept change.

headline.about: The single source for every number the README, submission/README.md, docs/evals.md, docs/track.md and the video quote. Read values.<key>.value (with .of for counts and .start for the baseline before any change). scripts/numbers-check.mjs fails when a document states something else.
headline.system: pre-mask, BRANE claims-v6.1, second classifier (classifier-v2), stricter route wins
not_rerun: the locked omar-test run (stopped unfinished at 06:00 CET on 21 Nov; no result recorded)
evals/compare.mjs with the classifier step (stopped unfinished; the compare figures are the run of 20 Nov)
evals/security.mjs on the deployed app with the classifier on by default (not started)
the agent runs with and without the lookup tool (classifier off when they ran)

points.change: Baseline: BRANE as handed out (all 25 categories allowed, no semantic rule), no harness
Policy claims-v6.1: identifiers get placeholders, special categories stay local, six semantic rules (health context, claim decisions, comparing claimants, profiling, rule overrides, criminal data)
Pre-mask before BRANE: BSN (11-proof), passport, policy and claim numbers, licence plates
Pre-mask also covers names, street addresses, email, phone, IBAN and date of birth

The complete system the app runs: the second classifier as shipped (policy/classifier.json, classifier-v2, its counted labels) on BRANE's local model after the pre-mask and BRANE claims-v6.1; the stricter route wins
